title: Part Two: London, The Financial Parent

sections.brief: Charters 1067/1189/1215, Magna Carta clause 13, incorporation by prescription, untouched in 1835, ceremonial county, liberties; why it is not sovereign (link bc_s01, bc_s06). Figure: timeline.

Lord Mayor, Aldermen, Common Council, Sheriffs, livery, Common Hall; business vote rules and numbers; 2025 election; City's Cash; police; open spaces, markets, port health. Figures: power structure; process for the business vote; key figures.
1571, functions, the under-gallery and not the floor, historical campaigns (1854, 1884, Goldney), 2011 budget, Lucas 2013, 2022 Markets Bill. Figure: claim and record.
Bank of England 1694/1946/1997, East India Company, Big Bang, FX and derivatives shares, output and jobs, offshore network with HMRC's answer, the statues decision. Figures: timeline; key figures.
Emancipation inside City institutions (Salomons, Lionel, Natty), gold fixing at New Court, Mansion House meetings 1840/1882/1890; the Waterloo legend linked. Figure: timeline.
JCT 1899, APC 1902, KKL Ltd 1907, Keren Hayesod 1920–26; JNF land figures; what being an English company meant. Figure: money chain.
Currency Board and Barclays, Arab banks, the IPC line and Haifa refinery, Night Squads, 22 Feb 1948 sterling exclusion, blocked balances, refinery shutdown. Figure: process flow.
Whitehall, not the Guildhall: Shaftesbury–Palmerston, Balfour, the Mandate, then the turn (1939, 1947, 1949); the Lord Mayor's 2018 mission. Figure: timeline.
Weigh the documented support against the limits; verdict. Figure: comparison (claim and record).
